newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products down - gasoline softer on US futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products down - gasoline softer on US futures.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly weaker on Friday except heating oil which held steady, traders said.
Gasoline was weaker after U.S. gasoline futures ran out of steam on Thursday. Swaps lost $1-2 a tonne and a eurograde barge traded at $226.50, down from a high of $230 on Thursday.

Gas oil eased $2 a tonne in line with September IPE, which was at $171.75 a tonne. Heatintg oil barge and cargo spreads were stable at a discount to the screen of 25 cents and premium of 50 cents respectively.
High sulphur fuel oil barges fell by more than $2 to trade at $95 and $94.50 fob for 1,000 tonnes each, with very low bunker demand and swaps that slipped slightly said to be pulling down the market.
